name: conference.SponsorWall
summary: The sponsors of an event by level, largest first: each level a heading, then its sponsors as tiles (their wordless mark when there is one, the name set in the display face, and a few words under it), larger tiles and marks for higher levels. A tile is one quiet surface with no border; a sponsor with a site has its name as the link. A Conference template part (Q64). Not for logos of customers on a company's home page (a logo strip), or for people (use Persona).
a11y: Each level is a section named by its heading, and its sponsors a list, so assistive technology says how many there are. Names are text, never a picture of text; a mark is decorative (empty alt) because the name beside it says who it is. A linked name is an ordinary link with its focus ring.
